[LNAM.2.2.5] **Pinned Unicode version — 16.0; the runtime is Unicode-free.**
`XID_Start` / `XID_Continue`, `Identifier_Status`, the NFC mapping ([LNAM.2.4]), and
the script sets ([LNAM.2.5.1]) are defined against a specific Unicode version and
change across versions. The language pins **Unicode 16.0**. **All Unicode processing — legality and normalization — is
compile-time.** The compiler applies the pinned version and emits NFC; the runtime
carries no Unicode tables and compares already-NFC-normalized names byte-for-byte
([LNAM.2.8], [LNAM.7.1]).

**The compiler's version implies the pin, and nothing else carries it.** Neither the artefact nor the platform signature records a
Unicode version. Advancing the pin is a language-version change, made only at a
minor release, so artefacts compiled against different pins belong to different
version series, which a runtime already keeps apart ([LDET.1.10]).
